get.description:
/v4/data/prediction/search

50 credits per API call

Unified search across events, tags and trader profiles. One query returns all three result types in a single response — pick the branches you care about with searchTags and searchProfiles. Designed for discovery surfaces (autocomplete, top-of-page search) where a single query needs to surface the most relevant entities of any kind.

Platform support

  • Polymarket only.

Filtering and pagination

  • q is the required search string — 2..128 characters. Single-character queries are rejected with 400 because they match an unhelpfully wide slice of the dataset.
  • limitPerType caps the number of results returned per branch (events, tags, profiles) — defaults to 10.
  • searchTags toggles the tags branch — defaults to true. searchProfiles toggles the profiles branch — defaults to false because most callers don't need it.
  • eventsStatus narrows the events branch by a free-text status (e.g. active); eventsTag is a comma-separated list of tag slugs (up to 50 entries). keepClosedMarkets overrides the default behaviour of hiding closed markets from the events branch.
  • sort is a free-text sort key forwarded to the upstream; ascending sets sort direction.
  • Pagination is page-based (not cursor-based) — advance via ?page=N+1. The response body carries data.pagination.hasMore and data.pagination.totalResults for paging decisions.

Other notes

  • Branches are populated independently — an empty tags array means no tag matches were found, not that the search failed.
  • events share the same shape as the /events listing endpoint, so the same client-side rendering can be reused.
  • profiles rows include only proxyWallet, name and pseudonym — additional profile fields (image, bio) are not exposed here.

parameters.description:
Search string (required). 2..128 characters. Single-character queries
are rejected with `400`.
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: 1-indexed page number for paging through results. Defaults to 1.
parameters.name: page

parameters.description:
Maximum number of results per branch (events / tags / profiles).
Defaults to 10.
parameters.name: limitPerType

parameters.description:
Toggle the `profiles` branch. Defaults to `false` — most callers don't
need profile results.
parameters.name: searchProfiles

parameters.description:
Narrow the events branch by status (free-text — accepts any value the
upstream supports, e.g. `active`).
parameters.name: eventsStatus

parameters.description:
Narrow the events branch to a comma-separated list of tag slugs. Up to
50 entries.
parameters.name: eventsTag

parameters.description:
Include closed markets in the events branch. Defaults to the upstream's
behaviour (closed markets are hidden).
parameters.name: keepClosedMarkets

parameters.description:
Sort key forwarded to the upstream (free-text — accepts comma-separated
field names).
parameters.name: sort

PredictionVolumeUnit.description:
Unit for `volume` and `totalVolume` fields. `usd` on Polymarket (dollar-denominated
notional); `contracts` on Kalshi (contract count — not USD).

PredictionMarketSource.description: Upstream platform attribution for a market or event row.

platformId.description:
Platform-native identifier. Polymarket condition id (0x + 64 hex) or numeric
event id; Kalshi market or event ticker.

url.description: Canonical public URL on the source platform.

PredictionMarketOutcome.description: One outcome of a market (e.g. YES / NO for a binary market).

tokenId.description:
Polymarket CTF token id for this outcome (numeric string). `null` on Kalshi —
Kalshi outcomes are not tokenised.

PredictionMarketResolution.description:
Resolution payload populated only after a market has settled. `null` on every
active or paused market.

outcome.description: Winning outcome name (matches one of the market's `outcomes[].name`).

resolvedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the market was resolved at.

txHash.description:
On-chain resolution transaction hash when available. `null` on Kalshi (the
resolution is recorded off-chain on Kalshi's side).

source.description:
Resolution source attribution (e.g. `uma`, `kalshi`). `null` when the upstream
does not expose it.

PredictionEventMarket.description:
Market row as nested inside an event. Same shape as the top-level
`PredictionMarket` minus the `chain` block (which is only surfaced on the
dedicated markets endpoints).

id.description: Platform-native market identifier (Polymarket condition id or Kalshi market ticker).

eventId.description:
Parent event id. Polymarket numeric event id, or Kalshi event ticker.
`null` when the upstream does not group this market under an event.

question.example: Will Elon Musk land humans on Mars by 2030?

description.example: Resolves YES if SpaceX confirms a successful crewed Mars landing by 2030-12-31.

tags.description: Free-form tag slugs. May be empty on Kalshi.

imageUrl.description: Image / icon URL for the market, when available.

status.description:
Verbatim upstream status string. Richer than the `?status=` filter enum —
values can include `paused`, `archived`, `settled`, `determined`, etc.

openTime.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the market opened for trading.

closeTime.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the market closes / closed for trading.

settleTime.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the market is expected to settle.

liquidity.description:
Quoted-resting-orders depth. `null` on Kalshi — the upstream markets feed
does not populate this; aggregate orderbook depth client-side if you need it.

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the market was created upstream.

PredictionEvent.description:
Top-level event row — a grouping of one or more markets sharing a question or
outcome set. Aggregate fields (`marketCount`, `totalVolume`, `totalLiquidity`)
are server-computed roll-ups over the event's markets.

id.description: Platform-native event identifier (Polymarket numeric id or Kalshi event ticker).

title.example: Will Elon Musk land humans on Mars by 2030?

description.example: Outcome resolves on confirmation of a successful crewed Mars landing.

tags.description: Free-form tag slugs. May be empty on Kalshi.

imageUrl.description: Image / icon URL for the event, when available.

status.description: Verbatim upstream status string. Richer than the `?status=` filter enum.

marketCount.description: Number of markets attached to this event.

totalVolume.description: Sum of nested-market volume, in `volumeUnit` units.

totalLiquidity.description:
Sum of nested-market quoted liquidity. `null` on Kalshi events because the
underlying market liquidity is not exposed there.

markets.description:
The event's markets. **Never null.**
- When the request passes `includeMarkets=true`, each entry is a full market object.
- Otherwise (default, `includeMarkets=false`), each entry is a **market ID string**.
  The id is exactly what the get-market-by-id endpoint accepts — copy an id and call
  `GET /v4/data/prediction/markets/{id}` to fetch that market's full details.

PredictionSearchTag.description: One tag row inside the unified-search response.

id.description: Tag identifier, when the upstream populates it.

eventCount.description: Authoritative count of events this tag is attached to.

PredictionSearchProfile.description:
One profile row inside the unified-search response. Includes only
identity-relevant fields — image and bio are not surfaced.

PredictionSearchPagination.description:
Page-based pagination metadata used by the search endpoint. Caller advances
with `?page=N+1` and stops when `hasMore` is `false`.

totalResults.description: Total number of results across all pages.

PredictionSearchResult.description:
Unified-search payload — events, tags and trader profiles for a single
query, with native page-based pagination.

events.description:
Matching events. Same shape as the rows returned by `/events`. Empty
when no event matches are found.

tags.description:
Matching tags. Empty when `searchTags=false` or no tag matches are
found.

profiles.description:
Matching trader profiles. Empty when `searchProfiles=false` (default)
or no profile matches are found.
